payload.purpose_context: Three follow-ups to the charter governance resolution Mission (#6442-#6444): synthesized styleguides have no source directive and float as roots; PROJECT_001 claims a mission-type link no traversal follows; two parallel language authorities disagree on vocabulary and cardinality, and Kotlin is miscounted as Java. Operator decisions of 2026-10-19 fix the model for each.
payload.purpose_tldr: Make synthesized styleguides reach-only through their directive, make the project-intent directive honest about its scope, and give charter one language authority with multi-language evidence and a jvm family tag.

payload.question: How should synthesized styleguides be governed (#6442)?

payload.final_answer: Reach-only when sourced: each styleguide-producing interview section gets a source directive and synthesis emits directive --suggests--> styleguide; the tactic reach-only logic and removal-sticks record are generalised by kind; edge-less styleguides keep today's activation semantics; the latent styleguide --applies--> edge is stripped as legacy.
payload.rationale: Operator decision 2026-10-19 (research: no synthesized styleguide has a source today).

payload.question: What should the synthesized PROJECT_001 directive govern (#6443)?

payload.final_answer: Project-wide intent: rename the slug/title to project intent via an upgrade migration, retire the dead requires --> mission_type edge, document root delivery.
payload.rationale: Operator decision 2026-10-19 (it is built from project_intent, scope 'All project work packages').

payload.question: How far should language detection be unified (#6444)?

payload.final_answer: One language-resolution authority owns observed and declared languages under one vocabulary; evidence gains languages (keeping primary_language); the neutrality gate exempts any listed language; languages enters the evidence hash only when it holds more than one language.

payload.question: Should kotlin become its own language token (#6444)?

payload.final_answer: Add a jvm family tag: java and kotlin both imply jvm behind the scenes, solving same-family / tech-stack concerns structurally.

payload.question: Which directive is a synthesized styleguide's source (#6442)?

payload.final_answer: A fixed section-to-directive table, always applied: testing_philosophy -> DIRECTIVE_034, quality_gates -> DIRECTIVE_030, documentation_policy -> DIRECTIVE_037; language_scope styleguides stay unsourced. The suggests edge is emitted even when the directive is not selected or active (strict reach-only).

payload.question: Where does the jvm doctrine retag happen (#6444)?

payload.final_answer: This Mission ships the general language-family mechanism (java and kotlin imply jvm; an artifact tagged jvm matches either) with fixture-pack tests; the retag of java-supply-chain and maven-review-checks to jvm is a port to spec-kitty-open-packs, filed as a follow-up.

payload.question: How does the Mission avoid Kotlin projects losing JVM doctrine (#6444)?

payload.final_answer: Retag java-supply-chain and maven-review-checks to jvm in core packs/built-in, re-seed spec-kitty-open-packs from this branch, and bump the core vendor pin in this Mission; build/test tokens map to jvm.
payload.rationale: Operator decision 2026-10-19 after the post-spec squad.

payload.question: Should styleguide sources travel as source_urns in the ADR-guarded request hash (#6442)?

payload.final_answer: Yes: source_urns as for tactics, amend ADR 2026-04-17-1, re-key fixtures, note new request hashes in the CHANGELOG.
payload.rationale: Operator decision 2026-10-19 after the post-spec squad.

payload.wp_title: Local-only reds: upgrade outside git, orphan ceiling, nag-test hermeticity
One language catalog and authority, kotlin token and jvm family
Multi-language evidence, neutrality gate, stable hash, JSON
Reach-only by kind: synthesized styleguides follow their directive
Project-intent directive: rename, dead edge, migration
JVM doctrine retag, open-packs re-seed and pin, synthesized golden, changelog
